message: No detected input validation: The code reads data via load_data and accepts argparse arguments but performs no visible schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths only; there is no remote fetch (URL, S3, HuggingFace, etc.) and therefore no checksum, signature, or authentication mechanism present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label distributions, checks labels against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is visible in the data preparation path shown.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads and instantiates AutoML models (AutoTabular, AutoTabularClassifier, AutoTabularRegressor) from the InsurAutoML package without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify model integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor or trigger detection logic anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or stress-test routines are imported or invoked anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of hashing/signing evaluation data, cryptographic isolation of the test set, or use of multiple independent evaluation sources to guard against metric manipulation; the code simply accepts a test dataset and evaluation metric string via CLI arguments.

No detected input sanitization: The code reads data via load_data and passes it directly through argparse arguments to the model without any schema validation, shape checks, or range/type guards on the inference input.
No detected output bounds checks: No post-prediction checks (NaN guards, probability bounds, threshold validation) are visible in the inference data-flow path of the provided code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular AutoML pipeline (AutoTabularClassifier/Regressor), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
